cells.text: Medium Trajectory | DoT Field Deals up to 63 [20] damage and inflicts x17+4.5 [x10+10] Scorch to enemies within 5 metres on impact, as well as creating a Solar Flare. Solar Flare: Deals 78 [25] damage every 0.267 seconds up to 13 times over its 4 second duration, for a total of 1,014 [325] damage to enemies within its 4 metre radius. Does not Scorch within its DoT Field, it inflicts up to x17+13 Scorch to Combatants inside the Solar Flare when it expires, although it's inconsistent. Inflicts x1 Scorch after 0.75 seconds, followed by x7.5+2.5 Scorch every 0.533 seconds, up to x53+27 Scorch over its duration. Solar Flare only begin dealing damage or inflicting scorch after 1 second of being created.
Solar Grenade lasts for ↑6 seconds. Solar Flare releases Magma Orbs around it every ? seconds, each dealing 125 [50] damage without falloff.

Enhances certain Grenade types: Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds. Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies. Solar Grenades linger for 2 seconds longer and release Magma Orbs that deal 125 [50] damage each. Magma Orbs do not have damage falloff. Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.

formatting_evidence.D45_blue_a4c2f4: Combatants: no Scorch during field; up to 17+13 at expiry, explicitly inconsistent.
formatting_evidence.D45_red_ea9999: PvP: 1 Scorch after 0.75 seconds, then 7.5+2.5 every 0.533 seconds, up to 53+27.
formatting_evidence.D45_small_type: Additive Ashes bonuses remain distinct from base amounts; impact 17+4.5 and PvP 10+10.

official.retrieval: Full article read on official alternate host, Warlock paragraph in Missing Patch Notes.
official.supports: Touch of Flame enhanced Solar and Fusion grenade damage decreased by ten percent in the stat rework. Relation to current Compendium bases remains unresolved.

requirements: Paid medium-trajectory grenade; impact radius 5 m, damage 63/20, Scorch 17+4.5 or 10+10 with separate Ashes contribution.
Fixed Solar Flare radius 4 m, base lifetime 4 s, Touch extension 2 s; field damage 78/25 per 0.267 s, stated 13 pulses.
Mode-specific Scorch: PvE expiry application versus PvP fractional periodic applications, preserving original formatting.
Touch magma orbs deal 125/50 without damage falloff; projectile emission cadence and physical parameters must be explicit calibration.
Base recharge 199.5 s and chunk scalar 0.5; reuse shared grenade resource and Heat Rises consumption.
uncertainties: The 1 s field startup plus thirteen pulses spaced 0.267 s places the last pulse at 4.204 s; source also states a 4 s duration. Startup, lifetime origin and last-pulse policy require explicit calibration.
PvP first Scorch at 0.75 s conflicts with the final one-second startup note unless separate timer origins are intended; source does not resolve this.
PvE expiry Scorch is explicitly inconsistent; no invented deterministic success probability.
Magma emission interval is marked unknown; trajectory, speed, spread, gravity, impact radius, number of orbs, overlap policies and ally/LOS rules need calibration.
Do not apply the historical ten-percent reduction again without knowing whether the table already incorporates it.
Complete production subclass assembly, formal content catalog, visuals and physical world restart are pending.

implementation.scope: Paid physical impact, independent fixed fields, target-class-specific fractional Scorch, Touch physical magma, shared energy and Heat Rises; test catalog only.
policies: Per-cast SOURCE field instance and own_timer discrimination; captured offense and Touch/Ashes survive unequip. Launched magma retains parameters after field expiry.
Current BODY/LOS/not-allied selection, excluding caster. Missing relative owner removes field on its next damage query. Damage revalidates selected life.
Only positive-loss, nonlethal APPLIED initial hits request Scorch. Periodic and expiry applications use independent shared status authorization.
Target-global configurable field-hit gate: first APPLIED field write wins. No gate on impact, Scorch or magma. Current Destiny cross-player arbitration is unverified.
World-result uncertainty stops without replay/refund. Local field gate does not suppress legitimate Char/Scorch/Ignition feedback.

synthetic_calibration.field: 1 second startup; 4/6 source seconds mapped to 4.25/6.25, base 13 pulses ending at 4.204. Not an original-game lifetime claim.
synthetic_calibration.scorch: PvP 1 at .75 then 7.5/10 per .533 seconds; PvE deterministic 17/30 on natural expiry, not a model of the source's stated inconsistency.
synthetic_calibration.overlap: Global per-target .267-second field gate; stacking and arbitration across players remain uncalibrated.
synthetic_calibration.magma: One orb at 1 second then every .6 seconds; uniform 0..2pi azimuth, vertical ratio 1, speed 6, gravity 12, drag 1, lifetime 2, launch lift .2, burst radius 1.5, contact normal .03 plus lift .1.
synthetic_calibration.impact: Speed 20, gravity 15, drag 1, lifetime 3; contact normal .03 plus lift .5. Falloff 1-.15*distance, domain 0..5 metres.
synthetic_calibration.damage: Shared offensive stages and .1 world projection; no falloff for field or magma; no additional historical .9 multiplier.

not_claimed: Complete production Solar Grenade / Touch of Flame catalog and loadout assembly
Calibrated current Destiny 2 numerical, timing, overlap or trajectory parity
Physical projectiles surviving a process restart
